pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo vāsitakena piññākena nahāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo vāsitakena piññākena nahāyissanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo vāsitakena piññākena nahāyissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo vāsitakena piññākena nahāyantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo vāsitakena piññākena nahāyissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:1.14.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī vāsitakena piññākena nahāyeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc89:2.1.10: nahāyati. payoge dukkaṭaṃ, nahānapariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.
